def factor_price_volume_dollar_coherence(df):
    """Price rank vs dollar-volume rank coherence, simplified from parent."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    window = 20
    dollar_volume = close * volume
    close_rank = close.rolling(window, min_periods=window).rank(pct=True)
    dollar_volume_rank = dollar_volume.rolling(window, min_periods=window).rank(pct=True)
    pv_corr = close_rank.rolling(window, min_periods=window).corr(dollar_volume_rank)
    df_copy["factor_price_volume_dollar_coherence"] = pv_corr
    return df_copy["factor_price_volume_dollar_coherence"]
